create_InitSender: create a ZMQ Sender with DEALER sockets for IPC request and response communication
create_InitConnector: create a ZMQ Connector with ROUTER sockets that binds to IPC endpoints
test_Sender_Send: test the Sender.Send method to serialize and send a message to connected peers
review_Connector_Receive: review the Connector.Receive method that receives multipart messages from connected Senders
run_WaitAll: run WaitAll to block until all channels in a dictionary have returned a reply
